data.gender_notes: Dipok is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Deepa' meaning 'lamp' or 'light'. The name Dipok signifies a radiant or luminous being, often associated with wisdom and knowledge in Hindu tradition. The name Dipok carries the meaning “Luminous, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dipok usually hope their child will grow to embody luminous, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
